map.依据无障碍设计规范，计算门洞、走廊最小净宽与轮椅回转空间直径，辅助居家改造: Compute the minimum clear width of door openings and corridors and the turning space diameter from accessibility design standards, assisting home renovation
map.📖 查看「轮椅通道计算 使用指南」: View the Wheelchair Passage Calculation User Guide
map.参考标准：《建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范》GB 55019-2021、GB 50: Reference standards: General Code for Accessibility of Buildings and Municipal Engineering GB 55019-2021, GB 50763. The clear width of a door opening should not be less than 800mm, the clear width of a one-sided ramp corridor should not be less than 1200mm, and the turning space diameter should not be less than 1500mm.
map.门扇开启后的有效通行宽度: The effective passage width after the door leaf is opened
map.建议采用推拉门或外开门: A sliding door or an outward-opening door is recommended
map.门槛不应高于 15mm 并斜面过渡: The threshold should not be higher than 15mm and should transition with a slope
map.一段走廊内有门: A door within a corridor segment
map.卫生间内需留出回转空间供轮椅转向: A turning space must be left inside the bathroom for the wheelchair to turn
map.居家与公共空间适老化改造中，需按轮椅类型核算门洞、走廊、转弯的最小净宽。: In age-friendly renovation of homes and public spaces, the minimum clear width of door openings, corridors and turns must be calculated by wheelchair type.
map.手动/电动/护理轮椅宽度不同，协助推行还需更宽以便并行。: Manual, powered and care wheelchairs differ in width, and assisted pushing needs extra width for walking alongside.
map.门洞应测『门扇全开后的实际通行净宽』，而非门框尺寸。: Door openings should be measured by the 'actual clear passage width with the door leaf fully open', not by the frame dimension.
map.算例：手动轮椅过门洞（自行推行）: Worked example: manual wheelchair through a door opening (propelled by self)
map.手动轮椅宽约 680 mm；门洞场景最小净宽建议 ≥ 800 mm（单侧操作余量: A manual wheelchair is about 680 mm wide; for the door opening scenario a minimum clear width of >= 800 mm is recommended (about 60mm operating margin on one side), and a sliding or outward-opening door is recommended to maximise the passage width.
map.算例：走廊通行（协助推行）: Worked example: corridor passage (pushed with assistance)
map.走廊自行推行最小净宽 ≥ 1200 mm；若需护理员并行协助，则 ≥ 1500: The minimum clear width for self-propelled corridor travel is >= 1200 mm; if a carer needs to assist alongside, then >= 1500 mm; where there is a door or a turn, raising it to 1500 mm is likewise recommended. A powered wheelchair is about 700 mm wide and a care wheelchair about 740 mm, derived the same way.
map.轮椅通道宽度取多少？: What width should a wheelchair passage be?
map.门洞 ≥ 800 mm、走廊自行 ≥ 1200 mm、协助并行 ≥ 1500 m: Door opening >= 800 mm, corridor self-propelled >= 1200 mm, assisted alongside >= 1500 mm, turning space >= 1500 mm (common age-friendly figures, subject to the latest standard). The wheelchair body itself is 680-740 mm wide, and extra operating margin must be left.
map.为什么门洞要测实际通行净宽？: Why should a door opening be measured by the actual clear passage width?
map.门框尺寸含门扇厚度与五金，门扇开启后真正可通行宽度更小；推拉门/外开门能显著增加: The frame dimension includes the door leaf thickness and hardware, so the truly passable width after the door opens is smaller; sliding or outward-opening doors significantly increase the effective clear width, hence the 'clear width when fully open' is the reference.
